definition: Simulates Pandemic Supply Stockpiles 2.0 operating for a day.
description:

title: Pandemic Supply Stockpiles 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Pandemic Supply Stockpiles 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Pandemic Supply Stockpiles 2.0 — next-gen stockpiles for pandemics.

Phase 1 — Prove (PPE reserves): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (stockpile logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (rotation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (surge manufacturing): stockpile hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and nations-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
